description: Side-by-side nutrition and scoring comparison for 2–10 products per call by barcode; a repeated barcode is compared once, so two identical barcodes yield one row, and barcodes past the 10th distinct one are listed in unprocessed rather than fetched. Returns a normalized table of energy (kcal), fat, saturated fat, carbohydrates, sugars, salt, protein, and fiber per 100 g, or per 100 ml for liquids, plus Nutri-Score, NOVA group, and Green-Score. Open Food Facts returns one preparation state per read, so figures for the prepared product arrive in a prepared object on the row, with the same columns and basis, and never fill an as-sold field; a row whose read returned only prepared figures gets one more product read, of the as-sold set its record stores, once the read of every barcode has settled, with stored_as_sold saying how it went. Designed for "which of these cereals is healthiest?" or "compare these pasta brands" workflows. Missing nutrition data for any product is preserved as absent — comparisons are not imputed. A batch is not all-or-nothing: barcodes that resolve are returned even when others fail, with confirmed-missing barcodes listed in not_found and failed fetches listed separately in failed. Scores carry regional formula caveats. Data under ODbL 1.0 — cite Open Food Facts in downstream use.

barcodes.description: Barcodes to compare, returned as one row each in input order; a repeated barcode is compared once, so two identical barcodes yield one row. One call compares at most 10 distinct barcodes: up to 100 are accepted, and those past the 10th distinct one are returned in unprocessed without being fetched. Example: ["3017620422003", "7622210100146"].

items.description: Product barcode, digits only: 4–40 digits after any leading zeros.

name: off_compare_products

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_error`: Open Food Facts returns a 5xx other than 501 or 504, serves an HTML error page with a 2xx or 5xx status, answers 2xx with a malformed envelope, closes the connection before finishing its answer, or is unreachable for a barcode — reported in that barcode's failed entry rather than failing the call. `upstream_timeout`: Open Food Facts did not answer a barcode within the request or retry deadline, or answered 408, 425, or 504 — reported in that barcode's failed entry rather than failing the call. `upstream_rejected`: Open Food Facts refuses a barcode with a 4xx other than 404, 408, 425, or 429, or with 501 Not Implemented — reported in that barcode's failed entry rather than failing the call. `rate_limited`: This server's own per-minute product budget is spent, or Open Food Facts answers 429 — reported in that barcode's failed entry rather than failing the call. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

failed.description: Barcodes whose fetch failed, with the per-barcode reason. Absent when every fetch completed. A barcode listed here is unknown, not absent from Open Food Facts — retry it with off_get_product before concluding anything about the product. A stored as-sold set that could not be read is not a failed fetch: it stays on its row as stored_as_sold.

items.description: A single barcode whose fetch failed.

barcode.description: Barcode whose fetch failed, as provided in input.

error.description: What went wrong for this barcode and what to do about it.

reason.description: Declared failure reason — one of upstream_error, upstream_timeout, upstream_rejected, rate_limited.

retryAfter.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying this barcode: the time until this server's own product budget frees a slot, or the Retry-After Open Food Facts sent with a 429. Absent when the failure named no wait.

mirror_snapshot.description: Present only when a row's source is "off_mirror". States that those rows come from the local copy as of their mirror_as_of, so an edit made to them since then is not reflected.

not_found.description: Barcodes Open Food Facts answered for, confirming no contributor record exists. Not an error — the product may exist but not yet be entered. Never used for a fetch that failed.

items.description: Barcode with no contributor record, as provided in input.

products.description: Comparison rows in input order — one per distinct barcode whose fetch completed, whether or not a record exists. Barcodes whose fetch failed have no row here; they appear in failed. Barcodes past the cap appear in unprocessed.

barcode.description: Barcode, echoed exactly as provided in input.

brands.description: Brand name(s), comma-separated. Absent when not yet entered.

carbohydrates_100g.description: Total carbohydrates in grams per 100 g, or per 100 ml for liquids, as sold. When the product read returned only prepared figures, read from the record's stored as-sold set instead (see stored_as_sold). Absent when not entered, or when that stored set was not read.

completeness.description: Data completeness 0–1. Low values mean many fields are missing.

ecoscore_grade.description: Green-Score (formerly Eco-Score) environmental impact grade: "a-plus" (lowest impact), then "a" through "f"; "unknown" when the data it needs is missing, or "not-applicable" for product categories the score does not cover. Often absent.

energy_kcal_100g.description: Energy in kcal per 100 g, or per 100 ml for liquids, as sold. When the product read returned only prepared figures, read from the record's stored as-sold set instead (see stored_as_sold). Absent when not entered, or when that stored set was not read.

fat_100g.description: Total fat in grams per 100 g, or per 100 ml for liquids, as sold. When the product read returned only prepared figures, read from the record's stored as-sold set instead (see stored_as_sold). Absent when not entered, or when that stored set was not read.

fiber_100g.description: Dietary fiber in grams per 100 g, or per 100 ml for liquids, as sold. When the product read returned only prepared figures, read from the record's stored as-sold set instead (see stored_as_sold). Absent when not entered, or when that stored set was not read.

found.description: False if the barcode has no contributor record.

mirror_as_of.description: ISO 8601 time of the newest Open Food Facts change the local copy reflects. Present only when source is "off_mirror".

nova_group.description: NOVA processing class (1–4). Absent when not assigned.

nutriscore_grade.description: Nutri-Score grade: "a" through "e", "unknown" when the nutrition data entered is not enough to compute it, or "not-applicable" for product categories the score does not cover. Absent when Open Food Facts sent none.

prepared.description: Figures for the prepared product, on the same columns and basis as the as-sold fields, read from Open Food Facts' *_prepared_100g keys and never derived or substituted for an as-sold figure. Open Food Facts returns one preparation state per read, so when the product read returned only prepared figures the record's stored as-sold set is read for the as-sold fields, and stored_as_sold says how that went. Absent when the read carried none of these figures.

carbohydrates_100g.description: Total carbohydrates in grams per 100 g, or per 100 ml for liquids, as prepared. Absent when this read returned no such figure.

energy_kcal_100g.description: Energy in kcal per 100 g, or per 100 ml for liquids, as prepared. Absent when this read returned no such figure.

fat_100g.description: Total fat in grams per 100 g, or per 100 ml for liquids, as prepared. Absent when this read returned no such figure.

fiber_100g.description: Dietary fiber in grams per 100 g, or per 100 ml for liquids, as prepared. Absent when this read returned no such figure.

proteins_100g.description: Protein in grams per 100 g, or per 100 ml for liquids, as prepared. Absent when this read returned no such figure.

salt_100g.description: Salt in grams per 100 g, or per 100 ml for liquids, as prepared. Absent when this read returned no such figure.

saturated_fat_100g.description: Saturated fat in grams per 100 g, or per 100 ml for liquids, as prepared. Absent when this read returned no such figure.

sugars_100g.description: Total sugars in grams per 100 g, or per 100 ml for liquids, as prepared. Absent when this read returned no such figure.

product_name.description: Product name. Absent when not yet entered by contributors.

proteins_100g.description: Protein in grams per 100 g, or per 100 ml for liquids, as sold. When the product read returned only prepared figures, read from the record's stored as-sold set instead (see stored_as_sold). Absent when not entered, or when that stored set was not read.

salt_100g.description: Salt in grams per 100 g, or per 100 ml for liquids, as sold. When the product read returned only prepared figures, read from the record's stored as-sold set instead (see stored_as_sold). Absent when not entered, or when that stored set was not read.

saturated_fat_100g.description: Saturated fat in grams per 100 g, or per 100 ml for liquids, as sold. When the product read returned only prepared figures, read from the record's stored as-sold set instead (see stored_as_sold). Absent when not entered, or when that stored set was not read.

source.description: Where this row was read: "off_api", Open Food Facts itself, or "off_mirror", this server's local copy of the Open Food Facts export, which serves a barcode it holds on a deployment that keeps one, so one comparison can mix the two. The stored as-sold read behind stored_as_sold, when one runs, reads the same source. Present on every row whose found is true.

stored_as_sold.description: How the read of the record's stored as-sold figures went for this row. Present only when its product read returned prepared figures and no as-sold one, which is when that second read of the record's stored nutrition sets runs (Open Food Facts serves one preparation state per product read, and prepared wins).

oneOf.description: The as-sold fields hold one stored set, never merged: per 100 g, or per 100 ml for liquids, when the record stores it so, else a serving of at least 5 g or ml scaled to 100 as Open Food Facts scales it, from the manufacturer, packaging, USDA, or another non-estimate source, in that order. Each nutrient is the entered value, or the one Open Food Facts computed when none was entered; IU and % DV figures are left out.

status.description: One stored as-sold set was read into the as-sold fields.

oneOf.description: Open Food Facts stores no entered as-sold figures for it that can be given per 100 g, or per 100 ml for liquids: the record stores no sets, or only prepared ones, ones estimated from the ingredients, servings under 5 g or ml, or figures in units that do not convert. The as-sold fields stay absent because nothing is entered.

status.description: The record stores no as-sold set the as-sold fields can be read from.

oneOf.description: The as-sold figures the record can still hold were not read, so the prepared figures are all this call holds. Never a failed call.

error.description: What went wrong reading the stored sets and what to do about it.

reason.description: Declared failure reason — one of upstream_error, upstream_timeout, upstream_rejected, rate_limited.

retryAfter.description: Whole seconds to wait before reading again: the time until this server's own product budget frees a slot, or the Retry-After Open Food Facts sent with a 429. Absent when the failure named no wait.

status.description: The stored sets could not be read; the call itself succeeded.

sugars_100g.description: Total sugars in grams per 100 g, or per 100 ml for liquids, as sold. When the product read returned only prepared figures, read from the record's stored as-sold set instead (see stored_as_sold). Absent when not entered, or when that stored set was not read.

succeeded.description: Number of barcodes that resolved to a found product.

unprocessed.description: Distinct barcodes past the 10th, in input order — never fetched, so nothing is known about them. Absent when the batch held 10 or fewer distinct barcodes. Compare them in another off_compare_products call (2–10 barcodes), or look a single one up with off_get_product.

items.description: Barcode left unprocessed, as provided in input.
